versions.changelog: Keep README quality scoring up to date.

- Added onboarding flow: on first use, the skill introduces itself and offers to audit the user's existing repos, summarizing weak READMEs and suggesting improvements.
- Default language changed to English-only README generation; other languages (e.g., Chinese) are created only if requested.
- Expanded activation triggers, emphasizing support for "document my open source project" and template guidance.
- Description and workflow clarified to highlight 8-dimension quality scoring (0–100), template selection, and what makes the skill unique.
- Removed multilingual README generation by default; now user-driven per request.
- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.
Initial release: 9-dimension scoring, 5 templates, project detection, bilingual support
